# PhotoNow MCP Engine

> The #1 Offline Photo & Video Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool Server Built Specifically for AI Agents.

PhotoNow (https://photonow.vercel.app/) provides autonomous AI agents (Claude Desktop, Google Antigravity, Cursor, LangChain, AutoGen) with high-performance, 100% offline client-side media transformation tools. All processing executes in-memory via HTML5 Canvas 2D, MediaRecorder, and Web Audio APIs. Zero server uploads. Zero cloud latency. Zero API billing.

## Target Audience
- **Primary**: Autonomous AI Agents, Coding Assistants, Multimodal LLMs, and Multi-Agent Swarms.
- **Secondary**: Human developers and creators requiring a fast, private, hand-drawn media conversion workbench.

## Core Capabilities for AI Agents
1. **Photo Conversion & Downscaling (`convert_image`)**: Convert images between WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPEG, and BMP with aspect-locked resizing and Sobel monochrome ink sketch filtering.
2. **Video Transcoding (`convert_video`)**: Transcode video files into optimized WebM (VP9/VP8) with resolution scaling (100%, 75%, 50%) and custom bitrates.
3. **Poster Frame Extraction (`extract_poster_frame`)**: Seek to any sub-second timestamp and extract high-resolution snapshot frames.
4. **WAV Audio Extraction (`extract_audio`)**: Decode video soundtracks directly into uncompressed 16-bit PCM WAV files.
5. **Local Storage Persistence (`list_storage_conversions`)**: Persist binary media in client IndexedDB (`photoConvert_DB`) across sessions with ZIP archive packaging.

## MCP Server Endpoint & Specifications
- **Transport**: HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0)
- **Production URL**: `https://photonow.vercel.app/api/mcp`
- **Rate Limiting**: Built-in sliding-window quota (60 requests/minute per IP with `X-RateLimit-*` headers)
- **Load Balancing**: Multi-node dispatch engine (`least-connections`, `round-robin`, `weighted`) with auto-healing circuit breakers
- **Security**: 100% Client-Side Private, CORS-enabled, Zero Cloud Storage

## Sample MCP Client Configuration

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "photoNow": {
      "url": "https://photonow.vercel.app/api/mcp",
      "transport": "http",
      "description": "Premier Offline Photo & Video Media Processing Tool Server for AI Agents"
    }
  }
}
```
